versions.content: The NvM module shall use the internal mirror as a buffer for all operations that read and write the RAM block of the NVRAM blocks with configured permanent RAM (or RAM passed by API parameter) for which the RAM (start) is not aligned to the NvMBufferAlignmentValue.
